CustomField.description: [??] - American Testing Program (ATP) Code is a set of numbers used for standardized testing such as SAT and ACT. A CEEB code is a standardized ID number that is assigned to a high school, college, or university. CEEB codes are issued by the Educational Testing Service (ETS). These 4- to 6-digit codes are mostly used in college entrance exams such as the SAT and ACT.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: American Testing Program (ATP) Code is a set of numbers used for standardized testing such as SAT and ACT. This field also represents the CEEB code by the Educational Testing Service.
